platform: KZSU Stanford Music Submission Portal and Physical Mail
manual_review_reason: KZSU publishes an official send-music portal and physical-mail addresses, but the music system requires a temporary browser cookie and secure session before its guidelines or fields can be reviewed. A human must open the first-party route, inspect the current requirements and consent, select digital or physical delivery, prepare the assets, and complete any submission manually.

WCBN accepts music from any musician who sends a hard copy of an album, preferably on CD or vinyl, and permits genre-specific care-of routing. A human must confirm that an eligible album and physical medium exist, select the appropriate general or specialist department, verify the current address, prepare the package, and approve production and postage before shipment.

KDVS explicitly requires physical submissions and publishes separate USPS and UPS/FedEx addresses plus specialist routing for electronic, experimental, hip-hop, punk and metal. A human must select the correct department, confirm the release format and current postal details, prepare the package, and approve production and postage before shipment.
